task.ques: First search New York's Central Park Zoo on Google Map, and then find the way to share the map. What is the generated sharing link?

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: Central Park Zoo’s generated Google Maps sharing link is https://maps.app.goo.gl/Gq8R7Kb5EwSoTRYv5
Evidence: Obtained through Share (“Дели”) → Copy Link. Opening this URL resolves to the Google Maps listing headed “Central Park Zoo”, with address “New York, NY 10021”. NOTES.md records the copied links and browser destination verification; final.png shows the verified zoo listing and map with the dialog closed.
